rappel-produit.tagline: Check product recalls in an instant
rappel-produit.description: Stay informed for safe consumption. Scan a product, search by name or category, and instantly find out if it's subject to an official recall. Protect your loved ones by sharing the info in one click! All data comes from the official government website rappel.conso.gouv.fr.

sections.title: 1. Introduction
sections.content: This privacy policy describes how Rappel Produit, developed by Yoan Soussand, collects, uses and protects your personal information. By using the application, you agree to the practices described in this policy.

sections.title: 2. Data collected
sections.content: Rappel Produit does not create user accounts and does not collect personally identifiable data. Data collected is limited to anonymous advertising identifiers used by Google AdMob for advertising delivery.

sections.title: 3. Government data
sections.content: Product recall information comes exclusively from the official French government website rappel.conso.gouv.fr. This data is public and Rappel Produit does not store it on its own servers.

sections.title: 4. Google AdMob advertising
sections.content: Rappel Produit is funded through advertising via Google AdMob. Google AdMob may collect and use data to serve personalized ads, including your advertising identifier (IDFA), approximate location data and anonymous usage data. This data is processed in accordance with Google's privacy policy: policies.google.com/privacy

sections.title: 5. App Tracking Transparency (ATT)
sections.content: In accordance with Apple's requirements, Rappel Produit will ask for permission to track your activity via Google AdMob. If you decline, non-personalized ads will be shown. You can change your choice from Settings → Privacy → Tracking.

sections.title: 6. GDPR consent — Google AdMob
sections.content: For users in the European Economic Area, Rappel Produit uses Google's UMP SDK to collect your consent in accordance with GDPR before any advertising data collection.

sections.title: 7. Data sharing
sections.content: We do not sell your personal data to third parties. The only data shared are anonymous advertising identifiers transmitted to Google AdMob for advertising delivery, subject to your consent.

sections.title: 8. Third-party services
sections.content: Rappel Produit uses Google AdMob (advertising) and the official government API rappel.conso.gouv.fr (recall data). These services are subject to their own privacy policies.

sections.title: 9. Security
sections.content: Rappel Produit does not store any personal data on its own servers. Communications with the government API are made via secure HTTPS connections.

sections.title: 10. Your rights (GDPR)
sections.content: In accordance with GDPR, you have the rights of access, rectification, erasure and objection. To exercise your rights regarding Google AdMob data, visit myaccount.google.com/data-and-privacy.

sections.title: 11. Children
sections.content: Rappel Produit is not intended for children under 13 years of age due to the presence of Google AdMob advertising. We encourage you to configure parental controls on the device.

sections.title: 12. Changes
sections.content: We reserve the right to update this privacy policy, particularly in the event of changes to Google AdMob's terms of use.

sections.title: 13. Contact
sections.content: For any questions regarding this privacy policy, contact us through the application page on the App Store.

mysterypix.description: The perfect game to spice up your evenings with friends or family! Choose a mysterious image, guess the hidden word and launch dares or truths. Play solo, multiplayer or with AI.

sections.title: 1. Introduction
sections.content: This privacy policy describes how MysteryPix, developed by Yoan Soussand, collects, uses and protects your personal information. By using the application, you agree to the practices described in this policy.

sections.title: 2. Data collected
sections.content: MysteryPix may collect certain data as part of its operation, including through integrated advertising and in-app purchases. This data may include anonymous advertising identifiers, progression data and information related to purchases made through the Apple App Store.

sections.title: 3. Local storage
sections.content: Game progress data, scores and preferences are stored locally on your device. This data is only accessible by the application and is permanently deleted if you uninstall the application.

sections.title: 4. Advertising
sections.content: MysteryPix integrates advertising for free version users. These ads are served through third-party advertising networks that may collect anonymous data for advertising targeting purposes. In accordance with Apple's ATT policy, your explicit consent will be requested before any data collection for advertising purposes.

sections.title: 5. App Tracking Transparency (ATT)
sections.content: In accordance with Apple's requirements, MysteryPix will ask for permission to track your activity. If you decline, non-personalized ads will be shown. Your choice does not affect your access to features. You can change your choice from Settings → Privacy → Tracking.

sections.title: 6. Purchases and subscriptions
sections.content: MysteryPix offers a Premium subscription to remove ads and access all features. Transactions are entirely managed by Apple. Subscriptions automatically renew unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage your subscription from Settings → Apple ID → Subscriptions.

sections.title: 7. Third-party services
sections.content: MysteryPix may integrate third-party SDKs for advertising delivery, subject to their own privacy policies. These services may collect anonymous data in accordance with your ATT preferences.

sections.title: 8. Data sharing
sections.content: We do not sell your personal data to third parties. Anonymous data collected through advertising networks is used solely for advertising delivery purposes.

sections.title: 9. Your rights (GDPR)
sections.content: In accordance with GDPR, you have the rights of access, rectification, erasure and objection. You can reset your advertising identifier from Settings → Privacy → Apple Advertising.

sections.title: 10. Children
sections.content: MysteryPix is not intended for children under 13 years of age due to the presence of advertising. We encourage you to configure parental controls on the device.

sections.title: 11. Changes
sections.content: We reserve the right to update this privacy policy at any time. Important changes will be notified to you via an application update.

sections.title: 12. Contact
sections.content: For any questions regarding this privacy policy, contact us through the application page on the App Store.

math-match-memory.description: Turn math into a fun memory game! Perfect for learning and practicing multiplication, addition, subtraction and division tables. Three difficulty levels to progress at your own pace.

sections.title: 1. Introduction
sections.content: This privacy policy describes how Math-Match Memory, developed by Yoan Soussand, collects, uses and protects your personal information.

sections.title: 2. Data collected
sections.content: Math-Match Memory does not collect any personally identifiable data. All data (scores, progress, completed levels) is stored locally on your device via SwiftData. No data is transmitted to external servers.

sections.title: 3. Local storage
sections.content: The application uses SwiftData, Apple's native storage technology, to save your progress data. This data remains exclusively on your device and is permanently deleted if you uninstall the application.

sections.title: 4. In-app purchases
sections.content: Math-Match Memory offers a one-time purchase through the Apple App Store to unlock full access. Transactions are entirely managed by Apple. We do not collect or store any payment information.

sections.title: 5. Advertising and tracking
sections.content: Math-Match Memory contains no advertising and does not use any tracking, analytics or behavioral data collection tools. Your use of the application remains entirely private.

sections.title: 6. Third-party services
sections.content: Math-Match Memory uses only Apple's native frameworks (SwiftData, StoreKit). No third-party SDK is integrated into the application.

sections.title: 7. Children and COPPA
sections.content: Math-Match Memory is an educational application designed for all ages, including children. The application does not collect any personal data, contains no advertising and offers no social interaction. It complies with the requirements of the COPPA (Children's Online Privacy Protection Act).

sections.title: 8. Security
sections.content: Your data is stored only on your local device. We do not collect any personal data, which eliminates any risk of data breach on our end.

sections.title: 9. Your rights
sections.content: You can delete all your data at any time by uninstalling the application. Your progress data will be permanently deleted from your device.

sections.title: 10. Changes
sections.content: We reserve the right to update this privacy policy at any time. Any changes will be reflected by a new update date at the top of this page.

sections.title: 11. Contact
sections.content: For any questions regarding this privacy policy, contact us through the application page on the App Store.

allfaves.tagline: Save what inspires you, find it in seconds
allfaves.description: Stop losing your favorite posts. Save any post, article or link from Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn or any website in one tap — and find it again instantly. Organize with custom categories, filter by platform, and share collections with friends. Your favorites, finally under control.
features: Save from any app with the Share Extension
Custom categories with icons and colors

sections.title: 1. Introduction
sections.content: This privacy policy describes how AllFaves, developed by Yoan Soussand, collects, uses and protects your personal information.

sections.title: 2. Data collected
sections.content: AllFaves does not collect any personally identifiable data. The posts, categories and favorites you save are stored locally on your device and synchronized only through your personal iCloud account. We have no access to your iCloud data.

sections.title: 3. iCloud and synchronization
sections.content: AllFaves uses iCloud to synchronize your data between your Apple devices. This data is stored in your private iCloud space and is governed by Apple's privacy policy. We have no access to your synchronized data.

sections.title: 4. CloudKit — Post sharing
sections.content: When you use the sharing feature, selected posts are temporarily stored in Apple's CloudKit public database for 24 hours, allowing your recipient to import them. This data is automatically deleted after expiration. Only posts explicitly shared by you are affected.

sections.title: 5. In-app purchases
sections.content: AllFaves offers a one-time Premium purchase through the Apple App Store. Transactions are entirely managed by Apple. We do not collect or store any payment information.

sections.title: 6. Advertising and tracking
sections.content: AllFaves contains no advertising and does not use any tracking, analytics or behavioral data collection tools. Your use of the application remains entirely private.

sections.title: 7. Third-party services
sections.content: AllFaves uses Apple's LinkPresentation to retrieve metadata and images from saved links. This operation is performed directly from your device without going through our servers. No third-party SDK is integrated into the application.

sections.title: 8. Security
sections.content: Your data is stored locally on your device and in your private iCloud space. We do not collect personal data, which minimizes any risk of data breach on our end.

sections.title: 9. Your rights
sections.content: You can delete all your data at any time by uninstalling the application and removing AllFaves data from Settings → iCloud → Manage Storage.

sections.title: 10. Changes
sections.content: We reserve the right to update this privacy policy at any time. Any changes will be reflected by a new update date at the top of this page.

sections.title: 11. Contact
sections.content: For any questions regarding this privacy policy, contact us through the application: About → Contact us.
